title: Reverse a string
statement: Write a function `reverseString(text)` that returns the text written backwards. For example, `reverseString('hello')` returns `'olleh'`. An empty string should return an empty string.
fallbackHints: Picture reading the word from the last letter to the first. What would you need to look at, one letter at a time?
You can visit each character of a string in order, the same way you visit items in an array. Think about how to build up a new string as you go.
Each new character you visit belongs at the front of what you have built so far, not at the end. Check where your current code puts it. What should the new string start as?
